scope: Read-only launch audit. Static API-reference verification and source review; not Android or user-machine execution.

apiReferenceAudit.executionNote: Archived verbatim script previously executed through stdin; not executed again during archival.

dexInspection.lambdaDesugaring: ExternalSyntheticLambda classes implement Runnable / ThreadFactory / listener interfaces in released DEX

sourceFindings.finding: aapt2 --custom-package com.ecojust.gamekit matches native source R namespace; manifest declares absolute com.ecojust.gamekit.MainActivity while appId is com.ecojust.neonrushtv. No mismatch found.
sourceFindings.checkerSupplement: Parent independently verified APK Checker parsing resolves that exact cross-package component; no component-concatenation defect in tested path.

sourceFindings.finding: NSD uses public API16/21 calls. Manifest INTERNET permission covers registration/socket access; no app-created multicast socket or Wi-Fi multicast lock is used. NSD register RuntimeException and socket-start Exception are caught; failed registration should still reach web.loadUrl.

GAME_URL exact local origin and intercepted assets logic are unchanged from 0.1.0. Asset URLs are served from APK through shouldInterceptRequest; no live DNS/TLS request needed for the allowed entry. Actual emulator probe remains separate.
HIFINi MainActivity builds native Views and does not create WebView; its login activity uses WebView separately. HIFINi main screen opening does not establish that a working System WebView exists.
Build pipeline/manifest/local-WebView setup unchanged. Additions are Wi-Fi TCP/NSD plus runtime/UI input integration. No new method exceeds API26.

Robolectric fixture runs source/Gradle SDK28, not released DEX on a physical device. Current static review cannot establish missing/OEM-broken WebView, GPU-driver failure, or actual process-crash reason; requires real device/emulator logcat.
